# terraform

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from terraform/lang.json and terraform/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//terraform:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//terraform:defs.bzl", "collect_providers", "terraform_library")
```

## Rules

### `collect_providers`

```python
collect_providers(label, own, deps)
```

Merges providers and fails when one source appears at two versions.

### `terraform_library`

Owns the Terraform files of one module for dx format and lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Terraform modules this module calls. |
| `providers` | `label_list` | no | Providers of the module, from the terraform extension hub. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Terraform files of this module. |
